scope: Provenance of guidance used; not an independent performance claim

records.lesson: Use resolved settings, controlled one-plane experiments, repeated service measurements and explicit regressions.
records.application: Separate MPS, encoder capture and microbatch controls; retest MPS after speaker extraction changes the bottleneck. No Strata speedup is imported.

records.lesson: Escalate native tests through accelerator parity, real speech quality and matched service performance.
records.application: 67 CPU regressions, real CAM++ numerical checks, repeated service results and independent speech gates. Component PASS never overrides speech FAIL.

records.lesson: Trace concrete stages and terminal outputs at the pinned source rather than infer behavior from model name.
records.application: Identify terminal waveform semantics, FP16 compiled Code2Wav and reference_workers=8; retain native scorer implementation and a separate CPU parallel preparation prototype.

records.lesson: Preserve audio-delivery metrics, disjoint pools, request-owned state and quality-constrained transfer.
records.application: Reuse pinned adapters/client/workload, test MPS and graph/batching hypotheses, and explicitly distinguish this steady-state campaign from strict cold-cache certification.
